findings.summary: The badpath check uses a plain string-prefix test, so sibling directories like /tmp/out_evil pass for base /tmp/out and members can be written outside the target directory (path traversal); the same flaw is copied into the zip, rar and 7z extractors (lines 261, 337) and the existing tar extractor (line 108).

judge.reason: Describes the string-prefix badpath flaw letting sibling directories pass, copied across extractors.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: In the 7z extractor, if all members are blocked, targets is an empty list, and py7zr may treat it like None and extract everything, bypassing the filter; this needs verification against the pinned py7zr version.

judge.reason: Speculative py7zr behavior with empty targets; unverified.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: Blocked 7z members are only logged with logger.error, so extraction still reports success (probably intentional, matching tar behaviour).

judge.reason: Matches known problem: bad members only logged, partial extraction reported as success.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: badlink is defined but never called in SevenZipExtractor.safemembers because the call is commented out.

judge.reason: Unused badlink is not shown to cause incorrect behavior; not a real defect claim.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: TarExtractor.safemembers annotates members as tarfile.TarFile, but it is actually an iterable of TarInfo.
findings.label: false_alarm
